provenance.locator: S3 narrative, "Vorgehen - Solide Rundherde" subsection, volume-based discharge-criterion sentence (first of three OR-combined discharge conditions; the other two -- VDT >600 days and general-condition status -- are explicitly excluded from this slice per HITL comment #5603995097)

recommendation.rationale: S3 states that a solitary, solid, incidental pulmonary nodule under CT surveillance may be discharged from further routine follow-up once its volume increase over approximately one year is below the source's stated 25% threshold, in a patient >=18 years old with no known malignancy history and not immunocompromised. This slice represents only that explicitly-confirmed, clinician-attested discharge criterion -- the app does not calculate volume change or elapsed time, and the source's own approximate one-year timeframe is not converted into an exact numeric interval. A criterion explicitly not met does not, by itself, imply growth or trigger any work-up recommendation in this Rule-Set Release.
